title: An award announcement
passage: F1: Our company won the council's community partnership award. It honors our technicians' volunteer repair sessions at schools, not our sales. Schools wrote to the council about how hands-on activities helped students understand electronics. The ceremony is at the civic center on June twelfth. We have six seats. Employees who joined a school visit get priority. Contact me by Friday if you want a seat. Next month we'll display photos from the program in reception.
passageZh: 本公司獲得協會的社區合作獎。獎項表揚的是公司技師在學校辦的志工維修活動，而不是銷售表現。學校寫信給協會，說明動手實作如何幫助學生理解電子學。頒獎典禮在六月十二日於市民中心舉行，公司有六個席位。參與過校訪的員工優先。如需席位，請在週五前聯絡我。下個月會在接待區展示計畫照片。
